audit.git_rationale: Git-metadata dependent in author judgment: the record names the worktree head it ran at. These records are fresh backend executions, which the helper never reuses.
audit.input_rationale: Inputs are the whole task worktree (hashed, nothing excluded), the Go launcher at /usr/local/go, and the Go module cache at /home/user/go/pkg/mod, which holds every resolved module; go.mod names go 1.24.0, which the installed launcher provides. GOCACHE points at a fresh empty directory for each run, so no earlier build output is reused. The Make target runs scripts/go-test-require-tests.sh (bash, tee, mktemp, grep, awk) through VALIDATION_CHILD_ENV (env). GO_INTEGRATION_FLAGS narrows the shard's go test to the one conformance case ActivityMarkerReviewRounds, as the task's Exit and the coordinator direct (a focused baseline, not the CI gate). The database is a disposable owned fixture that this helper prepares and removes; its server is the backend probe. HOME is inventoried by fingerprint and the target reads no HOME configuration. No output directory is excluded. The PostgreSQL server is the helper's own managed container, removed after the run.
